scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @nova/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts/check-i18n.mjs scripts/check-secrets.mjs scripts/check-schemes.mjs scripts/run-evals.mjs scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs scripts/staging-load.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/web apps/api packages/shared config scripts/check-i18n.mjs scripts/check-secrets.mjs scripts/check-schemes.mjs scripts/run-evals.mjs scripts/run-real-provider-evals.mjs scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs scripts/staging-load.mjs tests/nova2 vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nova/shared && npm run build --workspace @nova/web && npm run build --workspace @nova/api

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
